instructions.meaning: ReviewCompass2の登録制用語集と改定履歴をEvidenceとして固定し、Task Contract中心のReviewCompass3へ選択的に適合した統合用語集、Intent原則、計画上の運用を作る
instructions.text: ReviewCompass2の用語定義を参考に，本プロジェクト用に適合させる．

session_evidence.retained_evidence: decision-scoped Human instruction, fixed predecessor source digests, adaptation disposition, current glossary and referencing artifact digests
session_evidence.retention_limitation: 会話全体の永続参照identityは取得できないため、適合指示、前身source、継承・置換判断、成果物Digestを本recordへ保持する

preserved_or_adapted: registered domain terminology before or within first normative use
one canonical term per concept with Japanese display and machine token
versioned semantic changes, aliases, retirement and retroactive registration
separation between human-readable glossary meaning and schema-enforced closed values
separation of execution independence from model independence
reuse, extend, merge and split_with_rationale classifications
replaced: six-stage SDD with the seven current development stages
three lanes with orthogonal work_origin and continuation_mode
Task description with versioned Task Contract
case with Delivery Work Item or Issue Record
single state ledger with component-owned state and Operational Provenance
approval stop point with Decision Authority, Decision Record and permit
proxy decision with evidence-based staged AI delegation
single shared-routine ledger lookup with Source Symbol Index, Reusable Routine Ledger and real-code inspection
deploy-manifest with deployment, project and integration manifests plus logical roots
not_carried_forward: fixed legacy gate vocabulary and review-wave
legacy unit-file and master-role inversion vocabulary
legacy review-method vocabulary until required by current Requirements
predecessor-specific paths, IDs, model counts and size constants

implementation_scope.included_now: human-readable consolidated glossary, manual documentation discipline, Intent principle, Plan reference and staged terminology-control design
implementation_scope.excluded_now: runtime terminology registry, unrestricted prose vocabulary scanning and general ontology
implementation_scope.future_condition: runtime enforcement requires a separate Requirements delta after manual operation identifies a concrete E2E gap

verification.glossary_reference_check: passed: consolidated Plan references the current glossary digest
verification.intent_reference_check: passed: glossary and consolidated Plan reference the current Intent digest
verification.predecessor_source_digest_check: passed: all four ReviewCompass2 source files match the source-record digests
verification.terminology_self_check: passed: workflow, authority, decision, provenance, reuse and deployment terms distinguish current concepts and map retired predecessor terms
